prompt: My sister ran inside and (say / tell) me our missing turtle was under the bush.
explanation_ru: После глагола сразу стоит адресат (me), поэтому нужен глагол tell в прошедшем времени (told). Глагол say напрямую с дополнением-лицом не используется.

prompt: The sign in the bakery window (say / tell) that the square fountain works again.
explanation_ru: О надписях и объявлениях говорят с помощью say (the sign says that…), а также здесь нет адресата, без которого глагол tell не употребляется.

prompt: Did the police officer ___ that your yellow bike was near the bridge?
explanation_ru: Глагол tell требует адресата сразу после себя без предлога to (tell you). Типичные ошибки — say you, tell to you или tell без адресата перед that.

prompt: We didn't say our parents about the new house keys until dinner.
answer: We didn't tell our parents about the new house keys until dinner.
accepted_answers: We didn't tell our parents about the new house keys until dinner.
We did not tell our parents about the new house keys until dinner.
explanation_ru: Типичная ошибка — использовать say с адресатом без предлога и конструкцией about. В значении «рассказать кому-то о чём-то» нужен глагол tell (tell our parents about).

prompt:
— What did the chef (say / tell)?
— Only that cold lemonade is back again.
explanation_ru: В вопросе нет адресата (кому сказал), поэтому нужен глагол say. Глагол tell в такой позиции требовал бы дополнения (например, tell you).

prompt: Liam almost dropped the teapot because he could not (say / tell) a word.
explanation_ru: Устойчивое выражение «не сказать ни слова» строится с глаголом say (not say a word), а не tell.

prompt: Before baking, Carlos (say / tell) me not to expect much, yet Tessa (say / tell) that our loaf looked golden.
explanation_ru: В первой части есть адресат и инфинитив (told me not to expect), поэтому нужен tell. Во второй части сразу идёт придаточное с that без адресата, поэтому нужен say.

prompt: What did the clinic receptionist (say / tell) to Paul that made him stand up twenty minutes early?
explanation_ru: Перед адресатом стоит предлог to (to Paul), с которым сочетается только глагол say. После tell предлог to не ставится.

prompt: Grandad winked and asked Owen not to (say / tell) anyone that he gives the dog cheese every morning.
explanation_ru: Сразу после глагола стоит адресат anyone без предлога, поэтому подходит только tell (tell anyone that…).

prompt: We arrived tired at the small guesthouse in Split with two heavy suitcases. At the desk, the owner smiled, (say / tell) hello and checked our names. Then he (say / tell) us that our tiny street room had been upgraded to a balcony facing the harbour. When I asked about the price, he laughed and (say / tell) that it was completely free.
explanation_ru: В первом пропуске используется устойчивое сочетание say hello, во втором — tell + адресат (us) + that, а в третьем — say + that без адресата.

prompt: Guess what: the text message from the shop (say / tell) my winter coat was in the locker. I ran downstairs in my slippers and brought the big box into our flat. Wait until I (say / tell) you what was actually inside: two bright yellow rain hats! The shop still hasn't (say / tell) sorry for the mix-up.
explanation_ru: О содержании сообщения говорят с глаголом say (the message said), перед адресатом you нужен tell, а «извиниться» передаётся устойчивым выражением say sorry.

prompt: Our band was packing up cables in the garage when Mateusz burst through the side door. At first nobody believed him because he enjoys (say / tell) jokes during practice. He waved his phone and (say / tell) to us, "The summer festival picked our song!" We promised not to (say / tell) our families until the festival poster comes out.
explanation_ru: «Рассказывать шутки» — устойчивое сочетание tell jokes (после enjoy нужен герундий telling). Перед прямой речью с предлогом to (to us) используется say, а перед адресатом без предлога (our families) — tell.

prompt: Over coffee in Helsinki, Piotr finally decided to ___ about who had made the giant scarf on the park statue.
explanation_ru: С существительным the truth используется глагол tell, а адресат ставится сразу после него без предлога (tell Lin the truth). Типичные ошибки — say the truth, tell to Lin или say Lin.

prompt: A voice over the station loudspeaker said that the express train to Ghent was twenty minutes late.
answer: A voice over the station loudspeaker said that the express train to Ghent was twenty minutes late.
accepted_answers: A voice over the station loudspeaker said that the express train to Ghent was twenty minutes late.
explanation_ru: Ошибки нет: глагол say не требует адресата перед придаточным с that. Типичная ошибка — заменить say на told без дополнения-лица.

prompt: During lunch, the gallery manager said to Yael that a visitor wanted to buy her harbour painting. → During lunch, the gallery manager told …
answer: During lunch, the gallery manager told Yael that a visitor wanted to buy her harbour painting.
accepted_answers: During lunch, the gallery manager told Yael that a visitor wanted to buy her harbour painting.
During lunch, the gallery manager told Yael a visitor wanted to buy her harbour painting.
explanation_ru: При замене say to на tell предлог to убирается, а адресат (Yael) ставится сразу после глагола; союз that можно сохранить или опустить.

prompt: Before Sofia could even (say / tell) Mateo why she was smiling so widely, he spilt his coffee because someone at the next table had already (say / tell) out loud that their group won first prize.
explanation_ru: В первом пропуске стоит адресат Mateo и косвенный вопрос с why, поэтому нужен глагол tell. Во втором адресата нет, а есть out loud и придаточное с that, поэтому требуется причастие said.

prompt: When Freya called all six of us over to the coffee machine, we braced ourselves for extra overtime. Nobody (say / tell) a single word while she opened her laptop, expecting bad news about the deadline. Instead, she smiled and (say / tell) us to finish at lunchtime on Friday as a paid half-day. "Are you (say / tell) the truth, or is this an early April joke?" asked Henrik, nearly dropping his mug.
explanation_ru: Устойчивое выражение say a word требует глагола say, конструкция с адресатом и инфинитивом (us to finish) — глагола tell, а «говорить правду» передаётся сочетанием tell the truth (здесь в Present Continuous: telling).

prompt: Although Rita avoided (say / tell) lies, she had never explained how she actually made her famous apple pie. At the neighbourhood dinner, everyone praised the crispy topping and asked for her secret recipe. Leaning closer, she finally (say / tell) to Olga that she had crushed plain oat biscuits over the burnt pastry at the last minute. "Please don't (say / tell) the neighbours, or they will stop inviting me," she laughed.
explanation_ru: «Говорить неправду» — tell lies (после avoid используется герундий telling). Перед предлогом to (to Olga) ставится say, а перед прямым адресатом (the neighbours) — tell.

prompt: Just as thirty tired passengers were preparing to spend the night at Tromso airport, the gate agent stepped up to the microphone and ___ boarding would begin in ten minutes instead of tomorrow.
explanation_ru: Без указания адресата перед придаточным с that используется только said that. Типичные ошибки — told that без лица, said + адресат без to и лишний предлог to после told.

prompt: Three hours before opening night in Stratford, Priya gathered the actors in the theatre foyer and told to them that all two hundred seats had finally sold out.
answer: Three hours before opening night in Stratford, Priya gathered the actors in the theatre foyer and told them that all two hundred seats had finally sold out.
accepted_answers: Three hours before opening night in Stratford, Priya gathered the actors in the theatre foyer and told them that all two hundred seats had finally sold out.
Three hours before opening night in Stratford, Priya gathered the actors in the theatre foyer and told them all two hundred seats had finally sold out.
Three hours before opening night in Stratford, Priya gathered the actors in the theatre foyer and said to them that all two hundred seats had finally sold out.
Three hours before opening night in Stratford, Priya gathered the actors in the theatre foyer and said to them all two hundred seats had finally sold out.
explanation_ru: Типичная ошибка — ставить предлог to после tell. Нужно либо убрать предлог (told them), либо заменить глагол на say (said to them).

prompt: At the bowling alley, Daria won two free lake boat tickets and wanted everyone's advice, whereas Kofi refused to reveal his choice. Which sentence fits?
options: Daria told to the group about the free boat tickets, but Kofi wouldn't say a word about who should go.
Daria said the group she had won two boat tickets, but Kofi wouldn't tell the truth about who should go.
Daria told the group that she had won two boat tickets, yet Kofi wouldn't say who he thought should go.
Daria said that she won two boat tickets, and Kofi told goodbye to everyone before the game finished.
explanation_ru: Третий вариант грамматически верен и точно передаёт ситуацию: told the group that (без to) и wouldn't say who (без адресата). В остальных вариантах допущены типичные ошибки: told to, said the group и told goodbye.
